title: Yellowed Golden Mediterranean Pasta Pilaf
description: A flavorful and healthy solo dinner dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese and al dente pasta, with a grassy and flaky texture, inspired by Mediterranean cuisine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the shredded Mexican cheese until melted and well combined with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Fluff the cooked pasta with a fork and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cheese and tomato mixture.
Season the pasta pilaf with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice, and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Transfer the pasta pilaf to a serving dish and serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
